data.name: Info_Work_Milestones_What
data.value: A milestone is a named goal. Its requirements are frozen when you open it. You link runs and debates to it. To close it, a judge audits it.

data.name: Info_Work_Milestones_Actions
data.value: Pick the backlog requirements and open the milestone. Link the runs and debates that make it up. Close the milestone: it asks your approval, like an audit. Read the report of the close. You can reopen the milestone.

data.name: Work_Milestone_PickRequirements
data.value: Requirements of the milestone (from the backlog)

data.name: Work_Milestone_NoBacklog
data.value: The backlog is empty. Note the requirements first in the Backlog section.

data.name: Work_Milestone_NothingLinked
data.value: Nothing is linked yet. Closing it needs at least one run.

data.name: Work_Milestone_NoReports
data.value: It has not been closed yet: there is no report.

data.name: Work_Milestone_Reopened
data.value: Milestone reopened. The previous report is kept.

data.name: Work_Problem_NoRequirements
data.value: Pick at least one requirement from the backlog.

data.name: Work_Problem_NeedsCriteria
data.value: "{0}" is mandatory and has no criteria.

data.name: Work_Problem_BadTokens
data.value: The token limit must be a whole number above zero, or empty.

data.name: Work_Problem_BadRuns
data.value: The run limit must be a whole number above zero, or empty.

data.name: Work_Problem_NoLimit
data.value: Set a limit of tokens, of runs or of both.

data.name: Work_Close_Explain
data.value: Closing a milestone means auditing it. A judge that did not write the code reviews it. Your approval is asked and it uses the usage limit of your plan.

data.name: Work_Close_Waiting
data.value: Waiting for your approval and the verdict of the judge…

data.name: Work_Refused_milestone_problems
data.value: the milestone has problems in its history.

data.name: Work_Refused_milestone_nothing_to_close
data.value: it has no linked run: there is nothing to audit.

data.name: Work_Refused_milestone_no_judge
data.value: nobody can judge it without repeating the company that wrote the code.

data.name: Work_Refused_log_not_intact
data.value: the decision history is not intact.

data.name: Work_Refused_milestone_audit_not_run
data.value: the audit did not run (it was not approved or it could not run).

data.name: Work_Refused_milestone_closing
data.value: a close of this milestone is already going on.

data.name: Work_Refused_milestone_requirements
data.value: the frozen requirements of the milestone are missing.

data.name: Info_Work_Backlog_What
data.value: The backlog keeps requirements you have not planned yet. Each change creates a new version. Nothing is deleted: what you retire leaves the list and its history stays.

data.name: Info_Work_Backlog_Actions
data.value: Write the requirement and choose its priority. Add the criteria that check it. Pick an item from the list to save a new version. Retire what you no longer want.

data.name: Work_Backlog_Retired
data.value: Item retired. Its history is kept.

data.name: Info_Work_Board_What
data.value: The board shows the state of each requirement of the milestone. Its columns come from the verified history. Nothing is dragged to Done: without an approved verdict, no card gets there.

data.name: Info_Work_Board_Actions
data.value: Choose a milestone in the Milestones section. Read which column each card is in. A card in review says why. Press View chain to follow its path.

data.name: Work_Board_NoMilestone
data.value: Choose a milestone in the Milestones section to see its board.

data.name: Work_Board_Read
data.value: Read from the verified history ({0} entries).

data.name: Work_Board_ProjectBacklogEmpty
data.value: There are no items in the backlog.

data.name: Work_Reason_WaitingForQuota
data.value: Waiting for the usage limit of your plan to renew.

data.name: Work_Reason_AwaitingAnswer
data.value: Waiting for your answer to a question of the agent.

data.name: Work_Reason_Blocked
data.value: It is blocked, for example by a restart that interrupted it.

data.name: Work_Reason_Challenged
data.value: You challenged the verdict and its review has not ended.

data.name: Work_Reason_EscalatedToPerson
data.value: The verdict leaves the decision to you.

data.name: Work_Reason_Unresolved
data.value: The judge could not decide with the evidence there is.

data.name: Work_Reason_RunFailed
data.value: The run failed or was cancelled.

data.name: Work_Rule_NeedsVerdict
data.value: No card reaches Done or Integrated without a valid, approved verdict.

data.name: Work_Rule_IntegratedNeedsDone
data.value: Today Integrated also needs Done: a delivery without an approved verdict stays in its column.

data.name: Work_Rule_ApprovedNotMet
data.value: Today an approved verdict that does not say the requirement is met leaves it in review.

data.name: Work_Rule_CloseNeedsRun
data.value: Today closing a milestone needs a linked run.

data.name: Work_Rule_TestsAndDocs
data.value: Today a change that only touches tests or documents counts as tests.

data.name: Info_Work_Chain_What
data.value: The chain joins a requirement to its delivery. It goes through the milestone, the task, the attempt, the change, the verification and the verdict. Only what is in the history counts.

data.name: Info_Work_Chain_Actions
data.value: Press View chain on a card, a milestone or an item. Open a diff, a saved test run or a verdict. A node without a link cannot be opened from here. Center the chain on any node.

data.name: Work_Chain_NoStart
data.value: Choose a card, a milestone or an item and press View chain.

data.name: Work_Chain_Empty
data.value: There is no chain to show for this node.

data.name: Work_Chain_NoLink
data.value: No link: the app has nowhere to open it.

data.name: Work_Verdict_Invalid
data.value: It is not valid: it does not count.

data.name: Info_Work_Participation_What
data.value: Here you see who took each role in a task, a run or a milestone. There are six roles and they are never mixed up. If no source says so, it reads No consta.

data.name: Info_Work_Participation_Actions
data.value: Press View chain on a card to choose the subject. Pick the task, the run or the milestone. Read who each role is and where it comes from. A role without a source is never deduced from another.

data.name: Work_Participation_NoSubject
data.value: Choose a card or a milestone to see its participants.

data.name: Info_Work_Links_What
data.value: A link joins two things of the work, for example a requirement and a saved version. The system proposes links it infers. They count only when you confirm them.

data.name: Info_Work_Links_Actions
data.value: Press View chain to choose the node. Confirm a suggestion if it is right. Retire a link and say why. A retired link stays in the history.

data.name: Work_Link_NeedsReason
data.value: Write why you retire the link.

data.name: Work_Link_Retracted
data.value: Link retired. It stays in the history.

data.name: Work_Link_NoSuggestions
data.value: There are no suggestions for this node.

data.name: Work_Suggestion_CommitMessageMention
data.value: the message of a saved version

data.name: Work_Suggestion_CommitTrailer
data.value: the marks of a saved version

data.name: Info_Work_Budgets_What
data.value: A budget limits the tokens or the runs of a project or a milestone. If an attempt would pass it, the engine does not launch it and says so. It does not widen the usage limit of your plan.

data.name: Info_Work_Budgets_Actions
data.value: Set a limit of tokens, of runs or of both. Choose the period it covers. Save the budget of the project. That of a milestone is fixed when it opens and never changes.

data.name: Work_Budget_Explain
data.value: The budget of the project is kept on this computer and never enters the repository.

data.name: Work_Budget_Saved
data.value: Budget saved. The engine reads it before launching an attempt.

data.name: Info_Work_What
data.value: Here you follow the work of the project: milestones, backlog, board, chain, participants, links and budgets. Everything is read from the verified history, nothing is invented.

data.name: Info_Work_Actions
data.value: Choose a section in the list on the left. Note requirements and open a milestone with them. Follow the board and walk the chain of each card. Set a budget if you want a limit.
